as_told.title: Tim Taylor gives Diana Pasulka a hierarchy of being

plain: A NASA program manager named Timothy Taylor is said to have laid out a "hierarchy of being" when a researcher named Diana Pasulka asked him how things are ranked. A guest named Matthew Pines brings it up, calling Taylor a once-anonymous but now "kind of known" manager at NASA, the US space agency, who has been "deeply involved" in "spooky subjects for a long time." Michels repeats it on a later episode: "you have Tim Taylor telling Diana Pasulka, here's the hierarchy of being." Neither teller spells out what the hierarchy contains. If true, it would mean someone inside the space agency claims to know how beings beyond ourselves are ordered.
